To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the Fortune 1000 companies' webmasters' evaluation of the quality of web sites is based on the following variables, in order of importance: (1) Information Quality, (2) Service Quality, (3) System Quality, (4) System Use, (5) Learning Capability, and (6) Playfulness.
Fortune 1000 website designers consider that the most important design features are those related to the marketing constructs, and the least important are those related to system use.

the marketing constructs of Learning Capability and Playfulness, the information systems constructs of System Use and Information Quality, and a new construct, System Quality, are significant to webmasters in their evaluation of quality in the design and use of consumer-oriented web commerce sites.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evaluation of the design quality of web sites for consumer-oriented electronic commerce.
the evaluation of web design quality for electronic commerce.
the quality of the design of consumeroriented electronic commerce web sites.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the Fortune 1000 companies' webmasters' perceptions are that a well-designed website for consumer electronic commerce should be designed to support learning, playfulness and service quality.
webmasters believe that a web site should have high quality information, be easy to use, and be entertaining to be successful.

the Fortune 1000's webmasters perceive the importance of the constructs of Learning Capability, Service Quality, System Quality and System Use in the design of well designed web sites used for consumer-oriented electronic commerce.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the Fortune 1000 companies are using the Web as a marketing tool to attract customers and to provide customer service, not as a transactional tool for selling.
the webmaster's evaluation of the quality of a site is a function of the quality of the information and services, and the quality of the site itself.
Fortune 1000 companies are designing web sites for consumer-oriented electronic commerce based on marketing constructs and information systems constructs.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the Fortune 1000 respondents' ratings for importance of the constructs in the design of a well designed web site for consumer-oriented electronic commerce are similar to the results of previous research on consumer-oriented electronic commerce.
Fortune 1000 companies have a good understanding of the importance of web site design and that their webmasters are aware of the issues involved in the quality of web site design.
Fortune 1000 companies are using their web sites for electronic commerce.
